author: Whatfinger
title: Multi-billion dollar plan sparks Albania's 'Flamingo Revolution' | DW News
text:
Protests against a planned luxury resort on Albania’s Adriatic coast are widening. At the center of the dispute is a tourism project linked to Jared Kushner, the son-in-law of US President Donald Trump. What started as outrage over construction in a protected area has grown into a broader protest movement against corruption and foreign influence.
